entries.a3f7263c6e98f6a4: It has formulated the 3-year "2027 Medium-Term Management Plan" toward the 100th anniversary of its founding in 2029, and is working to realize its "desired state" for the 100th anniversary. In the power field, it expects growth in power demand from the rapid increase in data centers and the construction and expansion of semiconductor plants, as well as demand from carbon neutrality initiatives; in the telecommunications field, it works to win orders for 5G base station equipment and materials and for life-extension work on communication towers; and in infrastructure fields such as transportation, it aims to win orders for the renewal of aging road-related facilities and to propose the undergrounding of utility lines.
